messages.subject: Shorter call with ggplot
parts:
I have data that looks like mtcars[1,]. I want to make plot with the xaxis as category names, yaxis will be the values of the first row.

I have these examples, the first is with barplot the rest with ggplot:

barplot(as.matrix(mtcars[1,]))

ggplot(NULL, aes(x = names(mtcars), y=as.numeric(mtcars[1,]))) + geom_bar(stat="identity")

qplot(x = names(mtcars), y = as.numeric(mtcars[1,]), geom = "bar", stat = "identity")
Warning message:
: `stat` is deprecated
Error: stat_count() must not be used with a y aesthetic.

Can I create same represenation with gg in less keystrokes?
